title: Neon Cycles component diagram
description: Neon Cycles: a Godot web export run in the browser, in a small page of its own, served behind icelander.net's sign-in by a Worker that also joins the engine file from its parts.

components.name: Neon Cycles
components.responsibility: One game: the Godot project, its page and its Worker, built and deployed together.

components.name: Godot game
components.responsibility: godot/: the arena, the riders and their AI, the trails, collisions, rounds, camera, HUD and effects, all built in code; exported for the web by build.mjs.

components.name: Page around the game
components.responsibility: web/: the loading screen's stylesheet, the favicon, the headers and boot.js, which starts the engine from the configuration the page holds as JSON.

components.name: Sign-in Worker
components.responsibility: worker/index.ts: sends anyone signed out to sign in before serving the page, streams the engine's parts back as one index.wasm, and serves every other file as a static asset.

components.name: icelander.net login service
components.responsibility: Says who is signed in and with which games: roles.

relationships.description: Exported by build.mjs into dist/, with the engine split into parts under 25 MiB.
Copied by build.mjs into dist/; the export's HTML comes from godot/web_shell/shell.html.
boot.js starts the exported engine (index.js, index.wasm, index.pck).
Serves the page and its files from the ASSETS binding.
Checks the site_session cookie through the ACCOUNTS service binding.
